draft.text: You came in for a follow-up after your recent chemotherapy treatment for stage three non-small cell lung cancer.
You are tolerating chemotherapy well with no major changes in weight or new symptoms.
You have a mild dry cough, sore throat, and decreased appetite, but no nausea, vomiting, or shortness of breath.
Your doctor will monitor your condition and symptoms during a follow-up appointment.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have been feeling a little more tired than usual and have a dry cough and sore throat.
We did not find any new problems during your visit, and you are tolerating your chemotherapy well.
You are experiencing some mild symptoms, such as a dry cough, sore throat, and decreased appetite, which may be related to your treatment.
Your next steps will be discussed at your follow-up appointment, where we will check your appetite and weight and continue your chemotherapy as prescribed.
